text:
eva: quick alert 2: TF apply tightened egress to privatelink proxies in eu-west and now several GPU nodes are failing keystore decrypt during bootstrap (KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied).
samir: confirmed. sample from node: "2026-03-24T08:17:12Z keystore: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied proxy=10.2.3.17". warmpool join stalled, CI deploys backing up.
olga: looked at the change  module/egress replaced the 10.2.0.0/16 superset with a curated list of /28s and one AZs proxy slipped out.
ops-oncall: opening INC-6177. immediate mitigation: allow gpu-subnets -> 10.2.0.0/16:443 temporarily. requesting emergency approval to modify SGs.
eva: emergency approved, do it and revert via TF PR.
samir: applying manual egress now:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu-provision --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
samir: rule applied. starting to see TLS handshakes resume. warmpool +5 in 3m.
olga: note: the privatelink proxy dropped keystore.decrypt telemetry during the outage window (08:08-08:20). SIEM will need re-ingest.
audit-bot: created SIEM ticket SIEM-1368 for backfill (missing keystore.decrypt events 2026-03-24T08:08:00-08:20:00).
infra-ci-bot: pipeline detected manual drift and blocked subsequent applies until a reconcile PR merges.
eva: opened PR to restore the superset rule and add a CI canary that curls /keystore/health via proxy from a GPU canary: https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/1037
olga: also adding an explicit per-AZ allowlist var and a unit test that fails if a CIDR shrink would exclude known proxy IPs.
ops-oncall: impact note  autoscaler spun fallback nodes in us-east; cross-region model pulls ~850GB, estimated egress +$1.25k. include in RCA.
samir: filing INFRA-520 for TF preflight (resolve proxy hostnames + assert CIDR superset) and INFRA-521 for rollout per-AZ canary smoke.
ops-oncall: INC-6177 -> mitigated after manual rule. keeping incident open until SIEM confirms re-ingest and PR merges.
eva: follow-ups: merge PR, add preflight check, confirm SIEM backfill, update runbook to require canary pass before apply. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: will update INC-6177 and SIEM-1368 as things progress.
